original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an AWS KMS customer-managed key with key rotation enabled, for encrypting database backups.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an AWS KMS customer-managed key with key rotation enabled, for encrypting database backups.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: KMS CMK for encrypting database backups with key rotation enabled

Parameters:
  KeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/db-backup-kms-key
    Description: Alias for the KMS key (must start with 'alias/')
    AllowedPattern: ^alias\/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: must start with 'alias/' and contain alphanumeric, '/', '_', or '-' characters.
  KeyDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: KMS customer managed key for encrypting database backups.
    MaxLength: 8192
  MultiRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a multi-Region primary KMS key.
  PendingWindowInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 7
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Waiting period for scheduled key deletion (in days).

Conditions:
  IsMultiRegion: !Equals [!Ref MultiRegion, 'true']

Resources:
  DatabaseBackupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Ref KeyDescription
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: !If [IsMultiRegion, true, false]
      PendingWindowInDays: !Ref PendingWindowInDays
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowRDSServiceGrant
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: 'true'
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub rds.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: AllowAWSBackupServiceGrant
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: 'true'
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub backup.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref KeyAlias
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DatabaseBackups
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: SecurityLevel
          Value: High

  DatabaseBackupKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KeyAlias
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DatabaseBackupKmsKey

Outputs:
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: KMS Key ID
    Value: !Ref DatabaseBackupKmsKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyId
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN
    Value: !GetAtt DatabaseBackupKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Description: KMS Key Alias
    Value: !Ref KeyAlias
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyAlias
